mtr_visionupgrade.config.title: MTR-VisionUpgrade Client Optimization Settings
mtr_visionupgrade.config.rail_render_dis:
Independently controls rail rendering distance (1 chunk = 16 blocks).
Set to 0 to follow vanilla Minecraft view distance.
★ Guaranteed to take effect even when connected to multiplayer servers!
mtr_visionupgrade.config.vehicle_render_: Vehicles beyond this distance are completely culled, eliminating unnecessary matrix transforms and draw calls.
mtr_visionupgrade.config.enable_interior: Automatically culls seats, handrails, interior materials, and riding players inside cars at a distance.
mtr_visionupgrade.config.interior_cullin: Distance beyond which interior details are culled (recommended 32 - 64 blocks).
mtr_visionupgrade.config.enable_frustum_: Culls off-screen PSD / APG platform screen door block entities, drastically cutting down draw calls at large interchange stations.
mtr_visionupgrade.config.enable_safepoin: Enable Rail Culling GC Safepoint Fix
Periodically yields thread safepoints during rail occlusion calculations to eliminate GC safepoint freeze on large rail networks.
mtr_visionupgrade.config.enable_iris_opt: Caches translucency topological render order and feedback arc sets when Iris shaders are active, dramatically reducing frame time overhead from ~40ms to ~0.5ms.
mtr_visionupgrade.config.enable_parallel: Utilizes a bounded ForkJoinPool to compute vehicle interpolation, bogie rotation, and occlusion in parallel, significantly reducing render-thread CPU bottlenecks.
mtr_visionupgrade.config.enable_rail_ada: Enable Distant Rail Chordal Deviation Merging (LOD)
Adaptively merges continuous rail curve segment step sizes beyond 48 blocks, slashing 50%~75% rail polygon vertices while preserving 100% sleeper count and spacing.
mtr_visionupgrade.config.enable_dynamic_: Enable Trilinear Mipmapping for Dynamic Textures
Generates mipmaps and applies trilinear filtering (GL_LINEAR_MIPMAP_LINEAR) for station signs, PIDS, and route maps, eliminating high-frequency aliasing and pixel flickering.
mtr_visionupgrade.config.enable_backface: Enable Station Route Map Back-face Culling
Skips rendering single-sided wall-mounted route maps when camera is behind them, reducing polygon count while strictly isolating and preserving JCM double-sided PIDS and LCDs.
